orders: Formal Hoover's sign test - examiner places hand under the heel of the "weak" leg and asks patient to push down with the opposite leg, testing for involuntary hip extension force
Assessment of weakness distribution and effort-dependency - testing for give-way weakness pattern with repeated examination
Test for entrainment - rhythmic tapping of the tremor to see if frequency changes to match the tapping rhythm
served: effect of voluntary action and anxiety

ORDER:
1. Test for distractibility - perform rapid alternating movements of the hands while observing the leg tremor to see if it temporarily stops
2. Assessment of gait pattern and observation for inconsistency between observed and reported disability
3. Test for non-anatomical sensory loss - midline split on vibration or pinprick testing of the legs
